from.place: Step 1: the canonical branch, the relative normalization N_f and the quasi-compact open immersion X -> N_f

title: Quasi-finite morphisms embed openly in the relative normalization
statement:
Let $f:X	o S$ be a separated morphism of finite type [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] which is everywhere quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], with $S$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $
u_f:N_f	o S$ be the relative normalization of $S$ in $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. Then $
u_f$ is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], there is a morphism $\iota_f:X	o N_f$ with $
u_f\circ\iota_f=f$, and $\iota_f$ is a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion].
